card.name: Wait-time wording after stopping an MAOI
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "should" in "at least 14 days should be allowed after stopping" in MAOI washout warnings. It also fires weakly on scattered word starts inside drug or medical terms.

modes.label: MAOI washout "should"
modes.description: The word "should" after "at least 14 days" in the sentence about waiting after stopping an antidepressant.
